title: Portfolio site (this one)
summary: Angular + Material, Markdown content compiled to JSON at build time.
body:
A lightweight site for **projects** and **posts** without a CMS: copy lives in `content/`, and a Node script writes `posts.json` / `projects.json` into `src/assets/content/` before `ng serve` / `ng build`.

GitHub remains the source of truth for code; this is just a clearer presentation layer.
